verdict.rationale: White-labeling an authorization flow is a fair question for an agent tool gateway that brokers OAuth connections to providers, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents custom branding of the consent flow or registering your own OAuth client ID and secret. The 'own key' feature covers team-supplied provider API keys for unmetered calls, and the OAuth/PKCE and self-host mentions are adjacent features, not white-label auth.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
